name: companion
description: Pets, familiars, and small traveling creatures

entries.value: Loyal Hound — tracks familiar scents, guards sleepers, and distrusts one apparently harmless NPC.
Barn Cat — excellent at finding hidden vermin, warm places, and unattended food.
Messenger Pigeon — reliably returns to one chosen home carrying a very small message.
Pack Goat — carries modest supplies, eats almost anything, and refuses obviously cursed paths.
Clever Rat — squeezes through tiny spaces and learns simple object-based instructions.
Watch Goose — loudly challenges strangers, invisible creatures, and anyone carrying bread.
Pocket Ferret — retrieves small loose objects and hides them in inconvenient places.
Mule — dependable transport with excellent footing and absolute veto power over unsafe bridges.
Lantern Finch — emits gentle light and becomes silent when predators are nearby.
Ember Newt — provides warmth, lights dry tinder, and sleeps inside cookware.
Moss Tortoise — slowly grows common medicinal herbs across its shell.
Whisper Crow — remembers voices and can repeat several short phrases with alarming accuracy.
Miniature Slime — harmlessly dissolves dirt, spoiled food, and occasionally important paper.
Clockwork Beetle — records one hour of sound and plays it back when wound.
Breeze Lizard — changes color with the weather and glides short distances between people.
Cave Bat — navigates complete darkness and returns when called with a specific whistle.
River Otter — swims, retrieves floating objects, and insists on opening shellfish during serious scenes.
Tiny Griffin — fiercely guards a single backpack and hunts insects with dramatic dives.
Blink Rabbit — teleports a few meters when startled but rarely chooses the safest direction.
Paper Dragon — folds itself flat, carries written notes, and breathes enough flame to seal wax.
Ghost Mouse — passes through thin walls and becomes visible after eating cheese.
Cloud Pup — a floating canine made of mist that can briefly conceal a person's face.
Pebble Elemental — a fist-sized stone creature able to sense nearby tunnels and worked masonry.
Moon Moth — absorbs weak magical residue and glows in the presence of active enchantments.
